sessions.title: A Verbs connected with gaining, winning and achieving
sessions.description_vi: Ghi nhớ các cụm từ thông thường liên quan đến 'gaining' (đạt được) hoặc 'achieving' (thành tựu).
sessions.value:
# Synonyms and confusable words 2

## A Verbs connected with gaining, winning and achieving

Note these typical collocations connected with ‘gaining’ or ‘achieving’.

| verb          | collocates with                                    | example                                                                    | comments                                                                      |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| gain          | power, control, access                             | The Socialist Party **gained** control of the National Assembly.               | Gain is often used with abstract nouns relating to political authority.       |
| gain [formal] | a reputation, publicity, recognition, an advantage | Her paintings **gained** recognition thanks to a major exhibition in New York. | Gain is often used with abstract nouns that suggest benefit to the ‘gainer’.  |
| win           | an award, a prize, a medal, a match                | He **won** a medal in the 2016 Olympic Games.                                  | Win is often used in contexts associated with competition.                    |
| win           | a battle, a war, an election                       | The Conservative Party **won** the 2015 General Election.                      | Win is often used in contexts associated with fighting.                       |
| earn          | a salary, money                                    | I **earn** $2110 a month.                                                      | You earn money by working for it.                                             |
| make          | a profit, money                                    | The company **made** a profit last year.                                       | You can make money by investing etc., not just by working.                    |
| achieve       | success, your goals, your aims                     | It’s difficult to **achieve** success in international sport.                  | Achieve is used mainly with abstract nouns.                                   |
| beat/defeat   | a team, an opponent                                | He **defeated** his opponent in the tennis final.                              | You win a match but beat/defeat an opponent. Defeat is more formal than beat. |

sessions.title: B Other words that are often confused
sessions.description_vi: Phân biệt các từ dễ nhầm lẫn như 'wear', 'carry', 'use' và 'spend'.
sessions.value:
## B Other words that are often confused

You’ll need to take warm clothes when you go to Alaska. (NOT **carry**)

I always **carry** my mobile phone whenever I go out. (NOT **wear**)

She was **wearing** a hat. (NOT **carrying**)

He kindly offered to **carry** my bag for me.

She’s **wearing** a dress. (NOT **using**)

He’s **using** a laptop.

### Common mistakes

Notice how **spend** is used when talking about time and money.

We **spent** three days in the mountains. It was wonderful. (NOT passed)

If you buy a big car you’ll have to **spend** more money on petrol. (NOT use)

Last night I **spent** two hours watching TV. (NOT stayed)

I **spent** an hour looking for the keys before I found them in my bag. (NOT passed)

image.value: a person gaining control of something

senses.definition_vi: Đạt được, giành được (quyền lực, sự kiểm soát, quyền truy cập).
examples: The Socialist Party gained control of the National Assembly.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường được sử dụng với các danh từ trừu tượng liên quan đến quyền lực chính trị.

use_prompts.question: How do political parties take control of a government?
How do hackers get into private computer systems?
How do big companies come to dominate a market?

dictation.text: The party gained control of the government.

paraphrase.source: The Socialist Party took control of the National Assembly.
paraphrase.model: The Socialist Party gained control of the National Assembly.

paraphrase.source: The hackers got access to the bank's computer system.
paraphrase.model: The hackers gained access to the bank's computer system.

image.value: a person gaining recognition for their work

senses.definition_vi: Đạt được (danh tiếng, sự chú ý, sự công nhận, lợi thế).
examples: Her paintings gained recognition thanks to a major exhibition in New York.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường được sử dụng với các danh từ trừu tượng mang lại lợi ích cho người 'đạt được'.

use_prompts.question: How do young artists become well known?
How do ordinary people become famous online?
How can small companies compete with big ones?

dictation.text: Her paintings gained recognition after the exhibition.

paraphrase.source: Her paintings became widely known thanks to a big exhibition.
paraphrase.model: Her paintings gained recognition thanks to a big exhibition.

paraphrase.source: The singer became famous after her video went viral.
paraphrase.model: The singer gained fame after her video went viral.

senses.definition_vi: Thắng (giải thưởng, huy chương, trận đấu).
examples: He won a medal in the 2016 Olympic Games.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường được sử dụng trong các bối cảnh liên quan đến cạnh tranh.

use_prompts.question: What is the greatest achievement for an athlete?
What awards can students receive at school?
Which awards are most important for film makers?

dictation.text: He hopes to win a gold medal at the Olympics.

paraphrase.source: He hopes to get a medal in the Olympic Games.
paraphrase.model: He hopes to win a medal in the Olympic Games.

paraphrase.source: Her film received the top prize at the festival.
paraphrase.model: Her film won the top prize at the festival.

image.value: a political party winning an election

senses.definition_vi: Thắng (trận chiến, cuộc chiến, cuộc bầu cử).
examples: The Conservative Party won the 2015 General Election.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường được sử dụng trong các bối cảnh liên quan đến đấu tranh.

use_prompts.question: What helps a political party succeed in an election?
Which historical battles are famous in your country?
How does social media help politicians get votes?

dictation.text: Which party will win the next election?

paraphrase.source: The Conservative Party got the most votes in the General Election.
paraphrase.model: The Conservative Party won the General Election.

paraphrase.source: Nobody can be victorious in a nuclear war.
paraphrase.model: Nobody can win a nuclear war.

image.value: a person receiving money for work

senses.usage_notes_vi: Bạn kiếm tiền bằng cách làm việc để có được nó.

use_prompts.question: Do you think teachers are paid enough?
Should the minimum wage be increased?
Should teenagers have part-time jobs?

dictation.text: She earns a good salary as a nurse.

paraphrase.source: I get paid a good salary every month.
paraphrase.model: I earn a good salary every month.

paraphrase.source: Many students get money from part-time jobs.
paraphrase.model: Many students earn money from part-time jobs.

senses.definition_vi: Tạo ra, kiếm được (lợi nhuận, tiền).
examples: The company made a profit last year.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Bạn có thể kiếm tiền bằng cách đầu tư, v.v., không chỉ bằng cách làm việc.

use_prompts.question: Why do some small businesses fail?
Is it possible to get rich from a hobby?
How do social media companies get their income?

dictation.text: Small shops find it hard to make a profit.

paraphrase.source: The company earned more than it spent last year.
paraphrase.model: The company made a profit last year.

paraphrase.source: Some people earn a lot of money by selling things online.
paraphrase.model: Some people make a lot of money by selling things online.

senses.definition_vi: Đạt được (thành công, mục tiêu, đích đến).
examples: It’s difficult to achieve success in international sport.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Chủ yếu được sử dụng với các danh từ trừu tượng.

use_prompts.question: What does it take to succeed in international sport?
How can students reach their academic goals?
What helps employees meet their targets?

dictation.text: She worked hard to achieve her goals.

paraphrase.source: It's difficult to be successful in international sport.
paraphrase.model: It's difficult to achieve success in international sport.

paraphrase.source: Our team reached its sales target this month.
paraphrase.model: Our team achieved its sales target this month.

image.value: a sports team beating another team

senses.definition_vi: Đánh bại (một đội, một đối thủ).
examples: He beat his opponent in the tennis final.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Bạn thắng một trận đấu nhưng đánh bại một đối thủ. 'Beat' ít trang trọng hơn 'defeat'.

use_prompts.question: Can you describe a match where your team won?
Do you let children win when you play games with them?
Can computers now play chess better than humans?

dictation.text: He beat his opponent in the final.

paraphrase.source: He won against his opponent in the tennis final.
paraphrase.model: He beat his opponent in the tennis final.

paraphrase.source: Computers can now win against the best chess players in the world.
paraphrase.model: Computers can now beat the best chess players in the world.

senses.definition_vi: Đánh bại, làm cho thất bại (một đội, một đối thủ).
examples: He defeated his opponent in the tennis final.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Bạn thắng một trận đấu nhưng đánh bại một đối thủ. 'Defeat' trang trọng hơn 'beat'.

use_prompts.question: How do weaker teams sometimes win against stronger ones?
How can a government be removed in a democracy?
Which battles are remembered in your country's history?

dictation.text: They defeated the champions in the final.

paraphrase.source: He won against his opponent in the tennis final.
paraphrase.model: He defeated his opponent in the tennis final.

paraphrase.source: The opposition party won against the government in the election.
paraphrase.model: The opposition party defeated the government in the election.

senses.definition_vi: Mang, vác (thường là vật gì đó).
examples: I always carry my mobile phone whenever I go out.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ hành động di chuyển một vật từ nơi này đến nơi khác bằng tay hoặc trên cơ thể. Không dùng cho quần áo đang mặc.

use_prompts.question: What items do people always take with them when they go out?
What should travellers bring in their hand luggage?
Do you think shoppers should bring their own bags?

dictation.text: I always carry my phone when I go out.

paraphrase.source: I always have my mobile phone with me whenever I go out.
paraphrase.model: I always carry my mobile phone whenever I go out.

paraphrase.source: Tourists should keep their passport with them at all times.
paraphrase.model: Tourists should carry their passport at all times.

senses.definition_vi: Mặc, đội, đeo (quần áo, phụ kiện).
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ hành động mặc quần áo hoặc đeo phụ kiện trên cơ thể. Không dùng để chỉ hành động mang vác đồ vật.

use_prompts.question: What do people put on for traditional festivals in your country?
Should employees have to follow a dress code?
Should people put on masks when they are ill?

dictation.text: She was wearing a hat in the sun.

paraphrase.source: She had a hat on her head.
paraphrase.model: She was wearing a hat.

paraphrase.source: Staff must put on a uniform at work.
paraphrase.model: Staff must wear a uniform at work.

senses.definition_vi: Sử dụng (công cụ, thiết bị, phương tiện).
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ hành động vận hành hoặc khai thác một vật gì đó để phục vụ mục đích. Không dùng cho quần áo đang mặc hoặc đồ vật mang theo.

use_prompts.question: What devices do students need for their studies?
What tools are essential in your job?
How do people get around in your city?

dictation.text: He uses a laptop for his homework.

paraphrase.source: For his homework, he works on a laptop.
paraphrase.model: For his homework, he uses a laptop.

paraphrase.source: Most people take public transport to get to work.
paraphrase.model: Most people use public transport to get to work.

image.value: a person spending time watching TV

examples: We spent three days in the mountains.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để nói về việc sử dụng thời gian hoặc tiền bạc vào một hoạt động hoặc mục đích nào đó. Không dùng 'pass' hoặc 'use' trong các cấu trúc này.

use_prompts.question: How long do tourists usually stay in your city?
What do young people waste their money on?
How much time do parents have with their children nowadays?

dictation.text: We spent a week in the mountains.

paraphrase.source: We stayed in the mountains for three days.
paraphrase.model: We spent three days in the mountains.

paraphrase.source: Teenagers pay a lot of money for clothes and games.
paraphrase.model: Teenagers spend a lot of money on clothes and games.
